using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class FormatTests
{
    private static readonly ILogger TestLogger = NullLogger.Instance;
    private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger = new();

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_EmptyString_ReturnsDefaultBindAny()
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("", 8080, logger: TestLogger);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Equal(1, result.Length); // IPv4 only in test env
        Assert.Equal(IPAddress.Any, ((IPEndPoint)result[0]).Address);
        Assert.Equal(8080, ((IPEndPoint)result[0]).Port);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_Localhost_ReturnsDefaultBindLoopback()
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("localhost", 8080, logger: TestLogger);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Single(result);
        Assert.Equal(IPAddress.Loopback, ((IPEndPoint)result[0]).Address);
        Assert.Equal(8080, ((IPEndPoint)result[0]).Port);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_ValidIpAddress_ReturnsSingleEndpoint()
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("127.0.0.1", 8080, logger: TestLogger);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Single(result);
        Assert.Equal(IPAddress.Loopback, ((IPEndPoint)result[0]).Address);
        Assert.Equal(8080, ((IPEndPoint)result[0]).Port);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("nonexistenthost12345")]
    [InlineData("totallyfakehostname")]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_UnresolvableHostname_LogsErrorAndReturnsNull(string hostname)
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(hostname, 8080, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("No IP address found")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_HostnameMismatchMachineName_LogsErrorAndReturnsNull()
    {
        // Arrange - use a hostname unlikely to match machine name
        var testHostname = "totallynotmyhostname";

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(testHostname, 8080, tryConnect: false, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("does not much acquired machine name")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task TryCreateEndpointAsync_UnresolvableHostname_LogsErrorAndReturnsNull()
    {
        // Act
        var result = await Format.TryCreateEndpointAsync("nonexistenthost12345", 8080, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("No IP address found")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryParseAddressList_EmptyAddressList_ReturnsDefaultEndpoints()
    {
        // Act
        var success = Format.TryParseAddressList("", 8080, out var endpoints, out var error, logger: TestLogger);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(success);
        Assert.NotNull(endpoints);
        Assert.Null(error);
        Assert.Equal(IPAddress.Any, ((IPEndPoint)endpoints[0]).Address);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryParseAddressList_InvalidAddress_ReturnsFalseWithError()
    {
        // Act
        var success = Format.TryParseAddressList("invalidhost123", 8080, out var endpoints, out var error, logger: TestLogger);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(success);
        Assert.Null(endpoints);
        Assert.Equal("invalidhost123", error);
    }
}
